reason: Benchmark discovery misses runtime-hosted and helper-built benchmarks; flags dead weight fns.
True "no postcondition" is common but rarely worth fixing; benchmark tests already run the call.
Misses weight helpers, closure-built and metered benchmarks; root-only calls dominate the rest.
Reads validity and XCM errors as dispatch results; assert_noop! is a style choice.
Asks for a Pays::Yes error-path test that no SDK pallet writes; errors already pay.
Field-name regex flags assertions on public state and .inner() results.
Events emitted in helpers; privileged single-value setters; missing event rarely worth fixing.
Counts test-harness assertions as mock setup; mock ratio is not a defect signal.
Unbounded Vec params are already priced by length fees or gated by privileged origins.
debug_assert! in math helpers is an intended debug-only precondition check.
Read Ethereum ABI decode as SCALE; taint starts at call params, real cases decode stored bytes.
Fires on the canonical call.get_dispatch_info() wrapper weight used by utility/proxy/sudo.
let _ = is already explicit; most discards are documented best-effort; closures (dispatchables) unseen.
Fires on genesis presets and qed-proved unwraps; safe and unsafe unwraps look the same.
Bounded small arithmetic looks like overflow-prone arithmetic; the real bugs were on Weight or in infallible fns.
All findings are in #[pallet::without_storage_info] pallets; FRAME already enforces MaxEncodedLen elsewhere.
Every key was an internal sequential index, not attacker-chosen.
Migrations use done-flags, state checks or idempotent writes instead of StorageVersion.
Every Vec in an event was bounded elsewhere (config max, BoundedVec input, validator set).
Length fees already price input; rule cannot see O(n) work in the body.
Per-item weight times count is a valid linear over-estimate; constants misread as components.
Hand-written DbWeight often sits beside an explicit proof-size budget, or in demo/template code.
sp_std paths are a dependency cleanup, not a defect; 58% of all output before it was turned off.
repr(u8) is cosmetic when discriminants are explicit and in range; the cast compiles the same.
Text match: cheap guard often reads storage too, or the read picks a branch that returns early.
Every divisor was a Get config constant; zero there is a misconfiguration, not runtime input.
FRAME dispatchables are transactional, so writes before ? are rolled back.
Style: annotation and turbofish compile to the same code.
Style: `for x in v.iter()` and `for x in &v` desugar to the same code; clippy::explicit_iter_loop covers it.
Style: glob imports cost readability, not correctness; clippy::wildcard_imports covers it.
RuntimeDebug is deprecated only from sp-debug-derive 15; every flagged repository locked 14.
allow(dead_code) is already a visible, deliberate choice; deleting the code is a reviewer's call.
Style: import placement in tests does not change what the test checks.
